title: nicipe natalensis

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant, but its bioactive constituents have been identified as a potential source of new medicines.
